name: 护士执业资格考试
description: 护士资格网上报名、准考证打印与全国考试日期。确认、审核和缴费按当地通知，个人轮次以准考证为准。
description_en: Nurse licensure registration, admission-ticket printing and national exam dates. Local notices govern confirmation, eligibility review and payment; individual rounds follow the admission ticket.

events.name: 2026年护士资格网上报名开始
events.description: 全国护士执业资格考试；报名确认、资格审核及缴费请查当地通知。每位考生随机参加一个半天轮次，以准考证为准；不推算“考后45个工作日”的成绩日期。
events.description_en: National nurse licensure exam. Local notices govern confirmation, eligibility review and payment. Each candidate attends one assigned half-day round as shown on the admission ticket. No results date is inferred from the stated 45-working-day interval.
